# VBEMHS

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Variational Bayesian Variable Selection and Inference in Bayesian Sparse Linear Models

## Installation

You can install the development version of VBEMHS from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

```{r message=FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("wat-sakamoto/VBEMHS")
```

## Example

Below is an example of application to `diabetes` dataset in `lars` package. 
The default is using the independent prior.

```{r message=FALSE}
library(VBEMHS)
library(lars); data(diabetes)
diabetes.lm <- VBEMHS_lm(y ~ x, data=diabetes)
```

If you use correction for underestimation of the error variance, use the option `s2_correct=TRUE`.
This is recommended when $n<p$.

```{r message=FALSE}
diabetes.VBEMHS_lm <- VBEMHS_lm(y ~ x, data=diabetes, s2_correct=TRUE)
```

If you obtain a trace along the global shrinkage coefficients on a grid sequence, run the following code:

```{r message=FALSE}
diabetes.VBEMHS_lm.trace <- VBEMHS_lm(y ~ x, data=diabetes, gs_trace=TRUE)
```

If you use the conjugate prior, with sigma2 estimated by posterior mode, run the following code:

```{r message=FALSE}
diabetes.VBEMHSc_lm <- VBEMHS_lm(y ~ x, data=diabetes,
      prior=VBEMHS_lm.prior(independent=FALSE),
      control=VBEMHS_lm.control(s2_estim="mode"))
```
